## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3><ol><li>Open Sections (scissors) on the left toolbar and click Tracciato under Alignments.</li><li>Enable Cross-section at station, then enter a distance in Station / KP (m) to move the cut along the road alignment.</li><li>Use Next station or enter another distance to compare road profiles.</li></ol><h2>Developer integration</h2><p>Import the road sample with <code>viewer.add()</code>. The SDK supplies alignment navigation and sections. Chainage values refer to the source alignment.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
